name: hackerone-mcp
description: HackerOne (competitions): me, discover, get_competition, my_entries. Every tool maps to a documented

platform_mcp_hackerone_api_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HACKERONE_API_USERNAME
platform_mcp_hackerone_api_username.description: API token identifier from https://hackerone.com/settings/api_token/edit (used as the Basic auth username).

platform_mcp_hackerone_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HACKERONE_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_hackerone_api_token.description: API token value generated on the same page (used as the Basic auth password).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no profile endpoint in the Hacker API; GET /hackers/payments/balance verifies the credentials and returns {data: {balance}}.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: GET /hackers/programs (page[number], page[size] ≤ 100): the programs visible to you. `id` is the program handle that get_competition takes. No text or status filter, so `query`, `kind` and `status` are not sent; no total in the response. offers_bounties, currency, state and your report counts stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: GET /hackers/programs/{handle}. `description` is the program policy (markdown). Scope lives at /hackers/programs/{handle}/structured_scopes (not mapped).

tools.name: my_entries
tools.description: GET /hackers/me/reports: your reports across programs (no program filter, so `competition_id` is not sent). Title, weakness and bounty timestamps stay in `raw`.
